_about: Hand-resolved generic step targets (goal 8, 2026-10-07): the walkthrough names a role or a place instead of an NPC. npc = an existing server NPC chosen from the walkthrough's description; trainer_of = that class's trainer nearest each class row's giver; spawn = an NPC/monster the server lacks, placed at the walkthrough's loc (name is the walkthrough's own word for it). Every entry is listed in the ledger.

A113|<guard>.why: walkthrough: 'Speak to any guard near the 2 towers, north of the double bridge at loc 36400, 18000'; the server has no guards there

A540|<Lethantis Association>.why: walkthrough: a Lethantis mage at the Lethantis Association, name not recorded; Scholar Nenet stands there (not a trainer)

A8|<Captain of Humberton>.why: walkthrough: the Captain in the middle of Humberton; Captain Ryder is Humberton's captain

A261|<future guild trainer>.why: walkthrough: seek out a future guild trainer (an advanced-class trainer, the one nearest Master Torr; the notes: any two advanced-class trainers count)

A261|<another guild trainer>.why: walkthrough: then seek another (the next nearest advanced-class trainer of another class)

H62|<Path of Essence master>.why: Path of Essence = Hero trainer, in the row giver's town

H148|<Bri Leith sentinel>.why: walkthrough: talk to a sentinel in Bri Leith; the Keep Sentinels are the realm's sentinels there

H1790|<Connla portal vaultkeeper>.why: walkthrough: the vaultkeeper at the tower by the Hy Brasil portal near Connla; nearest vault keeper to Connla

H1796|<old man in Tir na mBeo>.why: walkthrough: an old man in the hut at the back of Tir na mBeo, name not recorded; Ardghal Corcoran stands at the back of town

H297|<faerie court>.why: walkthrough: the faerie court (jesters, advisers, maidens; red to 47) at about 50k,53k in the Cursed Forest, night to dawn

H500b|<hag>.why: walkthrough: the hag roams the Bog of Cullen near 42.2k,17.1k and looks like one who is dead; say 'need aid'

M205|<Witch>.why: walkthrough: the witch stands under a tree at 20.5k,9k in Skona Ravine, blue to a level 26

M1804|<Albion leader>.why: walkthrough: the Albion leader (purple to 48) roams a camp at 9000,12000 northwest of Nottmoor Faste

H681|Hervelina.why: Immortal Gift: Hervelina is the server's 'Hervelina the hermit' in Treibh Caillte
